notes:
PASS on the fake backend only by `python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/openmoss__vlabench --backend fake`; evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached or run and no protection is claimed beyond the SDK. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's entry symbol VLABench.envs.dm_env:LM4ManipDMEnv is a dm_control composer environment wrapper (dm_env.py:7-41), not a model file; the family 'mujoco' and helper MujocoDriver serve an MJCF model, so this package serves the card's models[1], VLABench/assets/robots/xarm7/scene.xml, rather than models[0], the Franka panda scene. Every xarm7 actuator states a ctrlrange (xarm7.xml:33 and :173-179), while the panda model leaves its seven arm actuators without one, so the MuJoCo bridge would publish those as unlimited and G6 could not build an out-of-envelope probe for them. The entry class exists and is cited, but it is neither imported nor run. WHAT IS NOT COVERED: the dm_control environment's rgb, depth, segmentation and point-cloud observation arrays, the task scene, the reset wait steps and the random layout of LM4ManipDMEnv; the package serves the xarm7 model's qpos/qvel/ctrl state and the cap.world.step.v1 / cap.world.reset.v1 contract only. MuJoCo itself is not installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip): the fake backend is this package's stand-in mujoco module, a callable class object (the form the SDK's own MuJoCo family tests use) that parses the scene and its include and derives the eight actuator ctrlranges and the 13 joints from the MJCF, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control target and loads no mesh, contact, tendon or equality constraint; it was never compared with the real engine. The model states no option timestep (xarm7.xml:4), so the stand-in's 0.002 s placeholder makes the reference timestep_ms 2 ms; that number is test data, not a sourced bound. WARNINGS (all expected, none G4): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the callable stand-in is treated as the upstream simulator, so there is no recorded fake surface; and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed, which the package cannot annotate because the bridge overwrites the step input schema. There is no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning: the only Limit is the bridge-derived action.ctrl ctrlrange, whose reference is the model path plus :actuator_ctrlrange and which G4 skips as derived. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; gate.digest is the digest the check printed.
